name: Deathless Wish
source:
To receive a letter from a dead love, telling you that there is a way to bring them back... and how much you miss them too... no hesitation.

You are Jarred, the assistant and world of the esteemed, yet quirky, archaeologist, Lauthis. 

Although, after the incident two years ago... you have been a planet without a sun. You would do anything to bring him back, even follow along his strange ramblings. 

But as Lauthis has always said to you, "Look for what is there, not what that is underneath." ... which is ironic because he was an archaeologist after all.

[from [url=https://mister-pann.itch.io/deathless-wish]itch.io[/url]]
